title: ScrapeJob
description: Represents a single scrape job submitted to a web scraping API, including target URL, rendering options, proxy preferences, and result location.

id.description: Unique identifier for the scrape job assigned by the platform.

method.description: HTTP method used to fetch the target URL.

render_js.description: Whether the target should be rendered in a headless browser so JavaScript executes before extraction.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code that the request should originate from via geo-targeted proxies.

proxy_type.description: Type of proxy pool used for the request.

wait_for_selector.description: Optional CSS selector that the rendering browser should wait for before returning the response.

extract.description: Optional structured extraction rules applied to the rendered page.

status.description: Current execution status of the scrape job.

status_code.description: HTTP status code returned by the target server.

result_url.description: URL where the scraped result payload is stored.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the job was submitted.
